item.title: 23 Nigerian states plan to spend $97.15 million on tech in 2026
item.description: Twenty-three Nigerian states have approved ₦132.45 billion ($97.15 million) to fund their technology ministries and digital ambitions in 2026, according to budget documents sourced from Budgit's Open States.

item.title: Chowdeck taps MyCoverGenius to introduce accident insurance for its 20,000 riders
item.description: Chowdeck riders will now be covered under insurance provided by MyCoverGenius to protect against accidents and temporary disability.

item.title: Nigeria’s Terra Industries names Nnamdi Chife VP military relations
item.description: As the defence-tech startup shifts from building products to executing military partnerships, Chife’s role is expected to focus on managing relationships with the armed forces and guiding strategy at the board level. The DICON agreement integrates Terra into Nigeria’s formal defence manufacturing structure and raises the stakes for coordination with military leadership.
